hooks.text: 主法术手动瞄准，其余法术自动索敌释放
hooks.excerpt: Choose from multiple archetypes to define your starting loadout. Your main spell is aimed manually, while all other spells auto-target nearby enemies, letting you focus on movement, survival, and securing loot.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 星座试炼包含限时生存、精英击杀、护送与拆图腾
hooks.excerpt: Each run is divided into Trials , cosmic challenges that test your skills, such as surviving for 3 minutes or defeating a set number of elite enemies before time runs out, escort relics or destroy ominous totems... Completing Trials rewards you with experience and upgrades.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 带容量成本的遗物永久成长并无限叠加法术属性
hooks.excerpt: Collect Relics , powerful remnant of power that boost any of your stats. Relics are a part of the permanent progression and unlock more player power in every run... Each relics has an associated cost, leveling gives you increased relics capacity and it's up to you to shape the fantasy you want to play. Also, there is no level cap , you can keep leveling to infinity and beyond . Each Relic grants stats : from global additional projectiles , to increased pierce , extra chain count , bonus damage , and more ! If a stat exists on a spell, chances are there’s a Relic that can supercharge it.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
